note: Multiple cohorts describing PLAA-associated neurodevelopmental disorder consistently report thinning of the corpus callosum on post-neonatal MRI.

evidence.text: Neuroimaging findings in affected patients in their first year of life included thinning of the corpus callosum alongside progressive microcephaly and delayed myelination.

evidence.text: Brain MRI characterization of seven patients with biallelic PLAA loss-of-function variants demonstrated progressive microcephaly, leukoencephalopathy, and a thin corpus callosum.
